    Teacher's notes

    Tommy, you brought wonderful energy to English today and a real drive to express yourself — it's a joy to learn with you!

    Strengths

    🙌 Super engaged and active — jumped into the conversation and shared details like building a "small community" from paper and clay!

    🎯 Said advanced words like "fountain" and "magnetic" clearly, and used them correctly in context.

    🎵 The sentence "I made it with my friends." came out smooth and natural, with lovely intonation!

    💡 Asked questions twice — like "Why do you want to be a frog?" — showing great curiosity and cross-cultural awareness!

    Room to grow

    👂 Paused a little when hearing the playful phrase "donated her eyes". Next time, feel free to guess a tricky expression with confidence!

    👄 "supplies" sometimes sounded like "surprise". A little listen-and-repeat after class will polish it.
